Field Notes.text: MIT. No licence key, no watermark.

tldraw.text: The tldraw SDK is free in development and needs a licence key in production: a commercial licence, or a discretionary hobby licence for non-commercial projects that shows a made with tldraw watermark.

Excalidraw.text: The Excalidraw repository is under the MIT licence.

Field Notes.text: None. The core package is vanilla TypeScript, and the React bindings are a separate package.

tldraw.text: The tldraw SDK is a React library, used through the Tldraw component.

Excalidraw.text: The @excalidraw/excalidraw package is installed together with react and react-dom.

Field Notes.text: @fieldnotes/sync-server is a WebSocket relay you run yourself. @fieldnotes/sync-redis adds Redis persistence.

tldraw.text: tldraw sync is a multiplayer sync library that you host yourself, with a Cloudflare Durable Objects template and a Node.js option built on @tldraw/sync-core.

Excalidraw.text: excalidraw-room is an example collaboration server for Excalidraw that you run yourself.

rows.label: Arbitrary HTML elements on the board

Field Notes.text: addHtmlElement puts any DOM node on the board, where it pans, zooms and sits in layer order with the drawing.

tldraw.text: Custom shapes can render HTML through the HTMLContainer component, and the SDK includes an embed shape.

Excalidraw.text: Embeddable elements render as iframes, and the renderEmbeddable prop can replace that renderer.

Field Notes.text: @fieldnotes/vtt adds square and hex grids, fog of war, a measuring tool and area templates.
